title: The Startup Leap @ Huckletree Oxford Circus — Eric Ries with Yvonne Bajela (LocalGlobe) and Maria Rotilu (Openseed.VC)
summary: Yvonne Bajela (LocalGlobe) and Maria Rotilu (Openseed.VC) host Eric for a live episode of The Startup Leap at Huckletree Oxford Circus on the third day of the UK book tour. The Startup Leap airs on Spotify and Apple Podcasts.
